title: Complete denitrification of nitrate and nitrite to N2 gas by samarium(II) iodide

material_class.structural_family: autoionized Sm(III) iodide THF ion pair

synthesis.procedure: Air-free side-arm flasks charged with SmI2 in THF were degassed by three freeze-pump-thaw cycles. Two equivalents of about 0.1 M SmI2 in THF were stirred with one equivalent of N2O (SI: 5 mL SmI2/THF; N2O layered onto the frozen solution at 77 K) in the dark for 48 h (two days) at ambient temperature, changing from deep blue to pale yellow. Removal of THF, filtration of solids, and evaporation, or redissolution in CH3CN followed by evaporation, gave yellow crystals of autoionized [SmI2(THF)5][SmI4(THF)2] (1).

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: THF removed and the solution filtered; evaporation of THF, or redissolution in CH3CN and evaporation, afforded yellow X-ray quality crystals of 1.

source_locations.location: N2O reduction paragraph and compound 1 crystallization
Experimental: N2O reaction and synthesis of 1

synthesis.procedure: The yellow solid from the SmI2/N2O reaction in THF (two equivalents of about 0.1 M SmI2, one equivalent of N2O, 48 h, ambient temperature after layering N2O at 77 K) was redissolved in wet acetone. Slow evaporation produced X-ray quality crystals of [Sm6(μ3-OH)8(μ6-O)(H2O)24]I8 (2). In the SI, the evaporated N2O-reaction solid from SmI2 (0.63 g) was dissolved in approximately 20 mL acetone, evaporated to yellow hygroscopic crystals plus a yellow oil, and the solids were washed (reported volumes include 10 mL of a hydrocarbon wash and cold diethyl ether).

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow product mixture redissolved in wet acetone and slowly evaporated to yellow hygroscopic crystals of 2 (orthorhombic Pnnm). SI describes separation from a yellow oil and washing. Combustion analysis was inconclusive because of residual solvent.

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear μ6-oxo μ3-hydroxo Sm(III) cluster with mixed MeCN/acetone/aqua ligands

synthesis.procedure: The main text states only that a similar cluster (3), with acetonitrile and acetone in place of aqua ligands, is obtained by recrystallization from THF/acetonitrile/acetone and is described in the ESI. The SI procedure evaporates the N2O-reaction mixture, dries the solid, dissolves it in 10 mL of a 25/25/50 THF/acetonitrile/acetone mixture, filters through Celite, and layers the filtrate with an equal volume of solvent; standing overnight gives colorless hygroscopic crystals of 3. No reproducible yield is reported.
